title: DeliveryLine Split Proposal v1
description: Story 3f-4 (R1) — the advisory decomposition a reviewer-style runner invocation emits over the spec/review-gate artifact when bundle.splitProposalRequested is true. A DISTINCT contract from review-result.v1: a split proposal is a decomposition (subtasks[] + dependencies[]) with its own lifecycle (open -> superseded / dismissed / approved), NOT a pass/concern/fail verdict, so it is harvested into split_proposals (NOT step_reviews). The backend redacts proposal_json and computes model provenance; this contract carries only what the runner authoritatively knows. It creates NO children/edges and does NOT move the parent (that is 3f-5).

subtasks.description: The proposed decomposition: ordered subtasks (1..20 on the happy path; the allOf below requires >=1 unless failureCategory is set). The ordinal is a 1-based index the dependencies[] edges reference; 3f-5 mints a child run per subtask in this order.

dependencies.description: OPTIONAL suggested ordering edges between subtasks (the subtask at fromOrdinal depends on the one at toOrdinal). 3f-5 turns these into run_dependencies edges; absent/empty means a flat fan-out.

summary.description: OPTIONAL one-line human summary of the proposed split.

reviewerModelIdentity.description: OPTIONAL self-reported reviewer model identity. The backend independently derives the authoritative reviewer identity from the proposal execution for provenance/self-review (AC7); this is advisory only.

failureCategory.description: OPTIONAL — a runner-self-reported failure (parallels review-result.v1). When present and non-blank, the backend records the proposal execution failed (graceful degrade, AC5/R5: the gate is never blocked) and writes NO proposal. Constrained to the FailureCategory wire values a runner can authoritatively self-report.

allOf.description: A SUCCESSFUL proposal (failureCategory absent or null) must carry >=1 subtask. A failure-shaped result (failureCategory set) may carry an empty subtasks array — the backend harvester degrades the panel to 'proposal unavailable' (R5) and writes no row.
